name: Wall of Wind
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create a wall of wind within medium range that is 30 ft high, 5 ft thick, and up to 30 ft long or circular with a diameter of short range. Uncheck any number of Conditions and roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Each creature that enters the wall, begins its turn within the wall, or is within the wall when it's created must roll Strength against the Difficulty. On a failure, the creature is lifted to the top of the wall and thrown out of it, away from you. On a pass, it is lifted halfway up the wall and thrown out of it in a direction it chooses.

For each Condition you unchecked (twice for Troubled), choose one:

  • The wall becomes 10 ft longer or taller, or the diameter increases by 10 ft.

  • Whenever you maintain concentration for this spell, you may move the wall or part of the wall an additional 5 ft in any direction you choose.

Describe how you create the wall.
successes:
✨: Any time a creature is thrown out of the wall, it falls prone.

🌞: Whenever a creature fails its roll against the Difficulty, a randomly-chosen item the creature is wielding is pulled from its grip and is thrown out of the wall in a random direction.
